verses.text: Of Solomon. O God, give Your judgments to the king, and Your justice to the son of the king.

segments.text: Of Solomon. O God, give Your judgments to the king, and Your justice to the son of the king.

verses.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness, and Your lowly ones with judgment.

segments.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness, and Your lowly ones with judgment.

verses.text: The mountains will carry peace to the people, and the hills justice.

segments.text: The mountains will carry peace to the people, and the hills justice.

verses.text: He will judge for the lowly ones of the people; he will save the sons of the needy, and will crush the one oppressing.

segments.text: He will judge for the lowly ones of the people; he will save the sons of the needy, and will crush the one oppressing.

verses.text: They will fear You with the sun, and before the face of the moon, [from] generation [to] generations.

segments.text: They will fear You with the sun, and before the face of the moon, [from] generation [to] generations.

verses.text: He will come down like rain upon freshly cut grass, like showers dropping [on] the earth.

segments.text: He will come down like rain upon freshly cut grass, like showers dropping [on] the earth.

verses.text: In his days the righteous will sprout forth, and [an] abundance of peace, until the moon [is] no more.

segments.text: In his days the righteous will sprout forth, and [an] abundance of peace, until the moon [is] no more.

verses.text: And he will rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

segments.text: And he will rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: Before him the desert dwellers will bow down, and his enemies will lick the dust.

segments.text: Before him the desert dwellers will bow down, and his enemies will lick the dust.

verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and the isles will return a gift; the kings of Sheba and Seba will bring near a gift.

segments.text: The kings of Tarshish and the isles will return a gift; the kings of Sheba and Seba will bring near a gift.

verses.text: And all kings will bow low before him; all nations will serve him!

segments.text: And all kings will bow low before him; all nations will serve him!

verses.text: For he will deliver the needy one crying out, and the poor one without a helper to him.

segments.text: For he will deliver the needy one crying out, and the poor one without a helper to him.

verses.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy, and he will save the souls of the needy.

segments.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy, and he will save the souls of the needy.

verses.text: From oppression and from violence he will redeem their soul, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.

segments.text: From oppression and from violence he will redeem their soul, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.

verses.text: Long may he live, and it shall be given to him from the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually; all the day he shall be blessed.

segments.text: Long may he live, and it shall be given to him from the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually; all the day he shall be blessed.

verses.text: There shall be an abundance of grain in the land; on the top of the mountains it shall wave, its fruit like Lebanon; and the [people] of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

segments.text: There shall be an abundance of grain in the land; on the top of the mountains it shall wave, its fruit like Lebanon; and the [people] of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

verses.text: His name shall be forever; unto the turning of the sun his name shall increase; and all nations shall be blessed in him, they shall call him blessed.

segments.text: His name shall be forever; unto the turning of the sun his name shall increase; and all nations shall be blessed in him, they shall call him blessed.

verses.text: Blessed [be] YHWH God, the God of Israel, the One doing marvelous deeds—Him alone!

segments.text: Blessed [be] YHWH God, the God of Israel, the One doing marvelous deeds—Him alone!

verses.text: And blessed [be] the name of His glory forever. And let all the earth be filled [with] His glory! Amen and Amen.

segments.text: And blessed [be] the name of His glory forever. And let all the earth be filled [with] His glory! Amen and Amen.

verses.text: The prayers of David son of Jesse have come to an end.

segments.text: The prayers of David son of Jesse have come to an end.
